Your reminders arrive
when they arrive.

Carrier Snail delivers every reminder by an actual snail, crawling across a real map toward you at genuine snail speed. Nothing is urgent. Nothing can be rushed.

How it works

① Set it up

Set up your to-do.

Write down something you need to remember — buy milk, call mum, anything. Hand it to a snail and send it on its way.

② The slow crawl

A snail slowly crawls toward you.

At around 0.03 mph, your snail takes its time across a real map. You can't truly rush it — and that's the whole point.

③ Finish & hatch

Finish it, earn an egg.

Complete your to-do before the snail arrives, and a new egg hatches into a snail.

Collect your snails

Hatch eggs, meet new companions, and build a stable of snails to carry your reminders — each with their own pace and personality.
